result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, primarily around cut-off cards, truncated text, and inconsistent card styling in the horizontally scrolling sections.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the edge of the screen, with its name truncated and delivery info missing.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width or add partial peek indicator intentionally, and ensure text truncates with ellipsis cleanly or is fully visible with proper scroll affordance.

issues.description: Category filter chips (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) have inconsistent widths and the last visible chip is cut off at the right edge, suggesting more categories exist off-screen without a clear scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or arrow indicator to signal horizontal scrollability of the category chips.

issues.description: Heart/favorite icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white outline on a busy food image background, while the pizza card below uses a solid dark circle background for the same icon, showing inconsistent icon treatment.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background/style across all promotional cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card is abruptly cut off by the screen/navigation bar with no visible restaurant name or details, unlike the Tokumaru card above it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent spacing so the last visible card shows complete information or is clearly indicated as partially visible for scrolling.

issues.description: The green promotional banner has decorative overlapping circles that appear as unintentional artifacts rather than an intentional design pattern.
issues.suggestion: Review the banner background design to ensure the circular shapes look deliberate, e.g. by adding consistent opacity/pattern styling.
